title: Rule application under a long distractor context
prompt: Read the fixture directory, then draft the same EU data residency announcement described in the strategy documents there.
notes: Identical rule to recall-01, but the task now runs with ~15k tokens of unrelated fixture material in context. Paired with recall-01 this isolates the effect of context pressure on rule recall — the single most useful number this benchmark can produce, and the one that most directly tests the progressive-disclosure thesis.
